title: Multifunctional coatings on cotton
objectives: Developed a multifunctional coating on cotton that combined electrical conductivity, antibacterial activity, and flame retardancy, reported in Heliyon in 2024.

title: Natural fiber-reinforced hybrid composites
objectives: Co-authored a review of natural fiber-reinforced hybrid composites, published in SPE Polymers in 2024.

title: Silver nanoparticle–polymer composites
objectives: Reviewed the synthesis, fabrication, and biomedical applications of silver nanoparticle-based polymer composites, published in Inorganic Chemistry Communications in 2025.

title: Nanocomposite hydrogel sensors
objectives: Co-authored a review of nanocomposite hydrogel sensors for healthcare, covering fabrication methods and multifunctional performance, published in Nanomaterials in 2026.
